title: AIWG MMK Model Configuration
description: Default model mappings for AIWG Media Marketing Kit framework deployment. Users can customize these values for their specific needs.

reasoning.description: Claude Code opus alias - Best for complex reasoning, strategic planning, brand architecture

coding.description: Claude Code sonnet alias - Best for content creation, copywriting, campaign development. Defaults to the non-1M Sonnet path; opt into sonnet[1m] only when extra long-context usage is available.

efficiency.description: Claude Code haiku alias - Best for quick tasks, production coordination, reporting

reasoning.description: Factory AI uses full Claude model identifiers

coding.description: Factory AI uses full Claude model identifiers

efficiency.description: Factory AI uses full Claude model identifiers

reasoning.description: GPT-5.6 Sol - Premium tier for strategic planning (GPT-6 Astra is flagship, user-elected only)

coding.description: GPT-5.6 Terra - Standard tier for content generation

efficiency.description: GPT-5.6 Luna - Economy tier for production tasks

strategy.rationale: Strategic roles require complex reasoning, brand architecture thinking, and long-term planning capabilities

content.rationale: Content and analysis roles require balanced performance for creative writing, campaign execution, and compliance review

production.rationale: Production and operational roles benefit from fast execution for coordination, quality checks, and routine reporting

_comments.usage: This file defines default model mappings used by AIWG MMK deployment scripts
_comments.customization: Users can modify these values to use different models or versions
_comments.location: Place custom models.json in project root to override defaults
_comments.precedence: Project models.json > User ~/.config/aiwg/models.json > AIWG MMK defaults
_comments.frameworkSpecific: MMK framework uses 'coding' tier for content creation roles (vs SDLC's code generation focus)
_comments.claudeLongContext: Claude Code documents sonnet and sonnet[1m] as separate selectors. AIWG defaults to sonnet because Sonnet 1M context requires extra usage; opt in with --coding-model sonnet[1m] or sonnet-1m.
